name: chart-honesty
description: Check every chart in a PowerPoint deck, or charts described in chat, for the ways a chart misleads: wrong chart type, a truncated or dual axis, 3D, pie misuse, a title the data contradicts, missing units. Gives the fix for each. Every finding cites a setting or value from the file, and a picture of a chart is never estimated from pixels. Reviews charts that already exist; it doesn't pick or build a chart, and it never edits the deck.
